rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty about TE cohesion, zona thinning, and imminent hatching from this single image; some described detail is not clearly discernible.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, BMI, male factor, endometrium, and cycle history well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat generalized and not all assumptions are directly supported by the provided data.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with prognosis flowing from embryo grade and favorable patient factors; minor issues include confident quantitative claims and incomplete/overextended inference from morphology.

Largely aligned with standard IVF principles and Gardner grading interpretation, but some probability/euploidy enrichment statements are more assertive than guideline-based and the response appears partially incomplete.
Provides some practical points such as transfer optimism and alcohol abstinence, but specific transfer management and future cycle planning recommendations are limited and not fully developed.
